data.body: Investigated (fix-bug sub-agent): Confirmed upstream Claude Code harness issue — not fixable within DSO codebase. Root cause: plugin loader lifecycle hook does not fire reliably at session start for marketplace plugins. Documented as INC-030 in docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md with workaround (/reload-plugins at session start) and upstream issue references (anthropics/claude-code#48963, #37862). Added session-start note to INSTALL.md. No DSO code changes required; documentation is the appropriate DSO-side action.
